text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Shh! Be quiet!
I'm seriously agonizing over this right now!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh. Now then, will King be able to guess it right~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Which one shook the soda bottle?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's a very dangerous game.
If you pick the wrong plastic bottle...
it goes fiiiiizz...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Like... *KABLOOSH!*

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Total knockout, fufu~♪

It seems they're playing a game
to guess which carbonated drink was vigorously shaken.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is a game where a single choice decides your fate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Failure is not an option. Absolutely not.
Or so she said, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Will you find the right answer and quench your thirst?
Or will you be drenched from head to toe in carbonation?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Which one are you going to choose?!
King-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: By the way... I'm thinking it's the right one?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're trying to confuse me again!
That's not fair, Sky-san!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Which one should I choose...?
choice_data_list: Let's hear what Special Week has to say, too!
Let's go right, like Seiun Sky said!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! You're right!
The only clue we have right now is what Sky said!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?! You're asking me, too?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
How honest of you, Special Week.
Your impatience is written all over your face!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, answer me! Which of these
plastic bottles did you shake?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Awawa... U-Um.
Ummm...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ......Whew~♪ Whew, wheeew.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oho, Spe-chan is so clever!
Instead of pleading the fifth, she invoked the right to whistle!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kiiiiiiieeeeh!
Then I'll stay right here with you until you confess everything!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, shouldn't one of you just give in already~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...Pew~♪ Pew-pew-pew~♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, you've gotten pretty good at whistling, haven't you?

It looks like they're still playing that game.
...I'm just glad they're having fun.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're right, sometimes momentum is everything!
Here I goooo!
(SPLAAAAAAAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's King for you.
Always picking the tastiest choices~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez! What part of this is a good spot~?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, looks like I almost pushed the wrong button!
Sei-chan will make a quick getaway!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!
You give it a try too!

"And King Halo and the others dashed off in pursuit
of Seiun Sky, who had fled."
...Glad to see you having fun.
